verdict.rationale: Inside the product, the documented AI feature is Query Assistant, which turns natural-language input into Honeycomb queries. That is AI help with querying, but it does not itself surface insights. The richer AI capabilities (diagnosing latency or error spikes, finding outliers, suggesting optimizations) are delivered through external AI agents connected via Honeycomb's MCP server, and the community account of LLM-generated hypotheses likewise uses the MCP route. Canvas appears only as the name of an MCP investigation tool, not as a documented in-app experience. Missing for 10: documented in-app AI-generated insights or anomaly explanations, in-product suggestion workflows that do not require an external agent, a documented Canvas in-app experience, and independent hands-on corroboration of in-product AI output.
